scope: Agent evaluation checkpoint compilation and source registration rejection
semantics: Guard before hook/options/helper lookup, parsing, registration, identifiers and context pushes at the listed entrypoints
Recipient and surrounding Agent checks on direct registrations
Cache hits and untracked compilation do not bypass rejection
Function parameter/body coercions precede the guard and are not rolled back
Nonstring eval, guest replacements, ordinary function syntax and JSON.stringify remain available
Valid JSON.parse/JSON.rawJSON/ParseJSON/ParseJSONModule reach Script parsing and reject; invalid JSON can throw a guest SyntaxError before the guard
Release permits compilation; capture/restore/terminal-open-checkpoint lifetime remain guarded
boundaries: Not automatic ownership, a source registry checkpoint, or full native/parser confinement
Native records, raw Parser/wrappedParse, RegExp parsing and arbitrary host implementations remain trusted
Direct native field/Map mutation is not intercepted
Standalone storage/control checkpoints do not gain Agent guards
No new public API, parser, interpreter, restore algorithm or effect permission
